one_line: The bid is set aside for SDVOSBC firms, and we hold no SDVOSB certification, so we can't bid as prime; on top of that, the work is recurring statewide porta potty service in Wisconsin under NAICS 562991 and PSC S214, and neither code is one of ours.
scope: The Wisconsin DNR wants standard and handicap-accessible porta potties at boat launches, parks, and other DNR-managed facilities across the state. The contractor delivers the units, pumps, services, and cleans them as needed, and gives the DNR a service schedule for each location. Delivery, removal, travel, and fuel are incidental and can't be billed separately. The initial term is 3 years, with two optional 1-year extensions by mutual agreement.
fit: Portable sanitation is part of our 'Facility Support and Utilities' core competency.

We have related sanitation past performance: the City and County of Denver (SC-00011558, climate-controlled restroom trailers, pump-outs, waste disposal, supplies) and USCG Station Lake Worth Inlet (70Z02826FMIAM0008, restroom/shower trailers and wastewater support).
Our work area is nationwide, and we've been in business since 1998, which helps with Attachment C's years-of-experience check.
red_flags: The set-aside is SDVOSBC. We are SBE/MBE only, with no SDVOSB certification, so we can't bid as prime.
NAICS 562991 isn't one of our NAICS codes, PSC S214 isn't one of our PSC codes (W023, W099, W045), and no GSA SIN of ours covers it.
The work is standard porta potties, a commodity product. Our sanitation fleet is trailer-based, and our price list has no porta potty line items.

The work requires recurring, as-needed pumping and cleaning at scattered sites across Wisconsin for up to 5 years. Our office is in Marina del Rey, CA, and no Wisconsin depot or service crew is documented.
Delivery, removal, travel, and fuel are incidental and unbillable, which raises our cost from a distant base.
The bid pack has 0 attachments. Every requirement here comes from HigherGov's AI summary, not the solicitation itself.
The estimated value is very wide ($150,000–$1,200,000), and no unit counts or location counts are given.
competition: There's no incumbent and no past awards by this agency under NAICS 562991. The only benchmarks are unrelated federal awards with 1–2 offers each: Sani-Can (2019, Eielson AFB, AK) and Energica Spurghi Srl (2008 and 2009, Italy). The set-aside limits the field to SDVOSB-certified firms.
price_signal: There's no useful benchmark. The NAICS 562991 + PSC S214 awards in the pack were $1,432 (2019), $4,934 (2009), and $11,769 (2008), all short-term federal jobs, so they don't compare to a 3–5 year statewide contract with an estimated value of $150,000–$1,200,000. Our price list has no porta potty rate. Its smallest restroom unit, the 13ft Luxury Shower-Restroom Combination Trailer (3 Stalls), is listed at $2,995.00 for 1-6 Days and $3,995.00 for 15days-1 month, but it's a different product and its billing basis is unspecified.
